rules: An adapter may record evidence inside its granted scope but may not silently accept it.
Every event is evaluated against the capability policy selected by its schema version and pinned by a sealing checkpoint.
Every non-null authority reference must resolve to an event or an allowlisted decision record.
C2 and C3 events require a resolved authority reference; v2 actor.auth_basis must name that same reference.
Every non-NONE effect requires a target, a resolved recovery reference, an idempotency key, and role permission.
A later capability-policy edit does not retroactively authorize an earlier event.
